async function mineEightOakLogs(bot) {
    // The function attempts to gather eight oak logs. It first checks if the required amount is already in the inventory and, if not, tries to mine any nearby logs up to the needed amount. If the target is still not met, it probes in two specific directions to search for more oak logs. If a log is found during the search, it attempts to mine more. If, after all searching, the inventory still lacks eight logs, it throws an error indicating the search was unsuccessful.
}
